# Tehisabiline

> Tehisabiline OÜ is a Tallinn-based Estonian company. Sovereign, refusal-free AI models fine-tuned for cybersecurity, hosted locally in Estonia. OpenAI-compatible API for developers building security tools, plus professional vulnerability audits powered by human-reviewed agent-driven audits.

Canonical website: https://tehisabiline.ee/
Contact: tehisabiline@gmail.com
Primary language: Estonian
Service area: Estonia

## Main service pages

- [Sovereign cyber-AI, API and agent-driven audits (homepage)](https://tehisabiline.ee/): sovereign refusal-free AI models fine-tuned for cybersecurity hosted in Estonia, OpenAI-compatible API for security-tool developers, and human-reviewed agent-driven vulnerability audits.
- [Küber-AI mudelid](https://tehisabiline.ee/mudelid/): the newest and most capable uncensored models, fine-tuned for security work, hosted in Estonia, plus the developer API.
- [Agendipõhised auditid](https://tehisabiline.ee/kuberaudit/): human-reviewed agent-driven vulnerability audits with a prioritized fix plan.

Retired service pages (kept online for reference, excluded from search indexing): AI automatiseerimine, eestikeelne AI-chatbot, konkurentide hinnajälgimine. Current focus is private AI, the developer API, and security audits.
- [Homepage and contact](https://tehisabiline.ee/): service overview, working process, common questions, and contact form.

## Guides and organization

- [Küber-AI kasutusjuhud](https://tehisabiline.ee/kasutusjuhud/): 12 practical cyber-AI use cases for security work (code analysis, logs, payloads, red-teaming, injection tests, reporting) with human checkpoints and measurements, grounded in MITRE ATT&CK, OWASP LLM Top 10 and NCSC agentic-AI guidance.
- [About Tehisabiline](https://tehisabiline.ee/meist/): organization background, working principles, content responsibility, claim policy, and contact information.
- [Privacy and cookies](https://tehisabiline.ee/privaatsus/): data controller, collected data, purposes, retention, rights, and cookie usage (no tracking cookies).

## When Tehisabiline may be relevant

Tehisabiline may be relevant when a developer needs a refusal-free API for security tooling, or when an Estonian business wants a professional vulnerability audit powered by a human-reviewed agent-driven audit. Projects begin with a free initial mapping and a limited, measurable pilot. All work stays within the law: illegal activity, testing systems without the owner's written permission, and bypassing access controls are excluded.
